- **What I checked:** the #central-team history and the shared files she has access to. Neither mentions a Brackenwater renewal date. I also couldn't see any Brackenwater contract, CRM or profile files.
- **What I said:** I haven't recorded 8 April anywhere. It can be confirmed from the signed contract, by the account owner, or by asking Brackenwater in writing. Once it's confirmed, I can set up renewal reminders.

I didn't send any mail, add any calendar events or ask for any approvals.
